utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar, call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-03-67-R77.4, in the matter of Vojislav Seselj. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Mr. Seselj, can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I need some time, Your Honour, to get used to the new technology. Yes, I can hear the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, before we go any further, Mr. Seselj, I was given to understand that you are not feeling well this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well enough to participate in this Status Conference.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Very well. Well, let me introduce myself. I am Judge Melville Baird. Judge Stefan Trechsel and I were appointed in this case by the President of the Tribunal on the 16th of December, 2011, in replacement of Judges Hall and Morrison. The Chamber has decided that I would conduct this Status Conference today. Now, the background to today's hearing is as follows. An initial Order in Lieu of Indictment was issued on 9th May 2011 and charges Mr. Seselj with contempt of the Tribunal pursuant to Rule 77 for failing to comply with orders to remove from his web site, inter alia, three books and five filings which allegedly include confidential information. At an initial appearance on July 6th, 2011, Mr. Seselj pleaded not guilty to this charge. On the 15th of July, 2011, the Trial Chamber ordered Mr. Seselj to remove from his web site by 8th August 2011 a fourth book which allegedly also contains confidential information. This was not done, and in the decision of 21st October 2011, the Trial Chamber amended the Order in Lieu of Indictment to include Mr. Seselj's failure to comply with the order of 15 July 2011. On 11 November 2011, a plea of not guilty was entered on Mr. Seselj's behalf at a second further appearance. Now, the Chamber is required pursuant to Rule 65 bis to hold a Status Conference within 120 days after the initial appearance. The purpose of the Status Conference is three-fold: (A) to organise exchanges between the parties so as to ensure an expeditious preparation for trial; (B) to review the status of the accused's case and to allow the accused to raise issues in relation thereto; (C) to allow the accused to raise issues in relation to his mental and physical condition and matters relating to detention. Now, there are currently no pending motions before the Trial Chamber. As was stated during the second further appearance, the Chamber understands that the supporting material to the Order in Lieu of Indictment has been provided to the accused. No further disclosure needs to be made. Now, at this stage, Mr. Seselj, are you in a position to state whether you would be ready to proceed with trial?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Ha, whether I will be ready to proceed. This is in the hands of God, not in my hands. And it is up to the skills of the dark Western powers and their intelligence services. I protest, Mr. Baird, for the fact that this trial did not start a long time ago. It could have started a year ago. There's no reason whatsoever to procrastinate, and since there has been so much delay, I'm inclined to start thinking that some political motives are at stake. If you consider that I violated the Rules and if you believe that the trial is so simple that there is no need to hire an amicus curiae - and I agree with that because there has never been any need to hire him - then there should not have been any reason to wait. We should have started already. I understand that the Judges have been replaced and that the two Judges, Hall and - what is his name? - Howard Morrison, Howard Morrison, did their best to escape this case, given the negative experience from the previous case. But as soon as the Judges have been replaced we could have gone on trial. Why are we not on trial already? Why are we holding a Status Conference instead of the proper trial. As far as I'm concerned, I'm ready for trial but you have to provide me with some procedural prerequisites. The Registry has disabled my communication with my legal advisors. About a month ago I had a scheduled visit of my remaining two legal advisors because Zoran Kasic has been removed from my case. The other two were supposed to visit me, Dejan Mirovic and Boris Aleksic, as well as my case manager Nemanja Sarovic. The Registry wrote me a letter stating that Dejan Mirovic and Boris Aleksic could visit me under privileged conditions and that Nemanja Sarovic, on the other hand, as my case manager, could not do that. There is no single case before this Tribunal in which a case manager has been deprived of his right to participate in conversations between the Defence and the accused. It is only my case that this has been happening. Since I was informed that there would be no privileged communication and there was a room prepared for us, a room that Mr. Karadzic and some other accused often use, the top-class accused who are of most significance for foreign intelligence services, that's why we concluded that every word of ours was being eavesdropped and that's why we did not say a word about any of my cases, including this contempt case. And this is already the third contempt case against me. In this trial this is what I demand. Dejan Mirovic should be able to visit me as well as my case manager Nemanja Sarovic. I have to be able to prepare my defence with them because I need to appear as my own witness in my own defence during trial and possibly invite two or three other witnesses. But I will be able to do that only if I am provided with the right for privileged communication. In my previous trial I brought ten witnesses and I wanted my legal advisors and case manager to be here to prepare the witnesses. This was not allowed and the witnesses appeared in the courtroom without any preparation. Half of the witnesses were not allowed to testify in open court and that's why they didn't want to testify. I hope that this will not repeat because this time I don't intend to call any of the witnesses who have ever enjoyed protective measures. I want to call those witnesses who understand my alleged contempt of court. The fact that I do not respect The Hague Tribunal is old news. The problem lies in the fact whether my contempt of the trial of The Hague Tribunal may be characterised as a crime or not and whether The Hague Tribunal is competent to prosecute this crime because my main thesis is that The Hague Tribunal has proclaimed itself as being competent to prosecute this crime. The Hague Tribunal claims that it has an inherent competency. It may have inherent competency or arrogated jurisdiction. This arrogated jurisdiction is based on the right to conduct proceedings on the case and not to describe the characteristics of the crime -- let's put aside the fact that there is a big problem whether contempt of court may be prosecuted and punished as a crime in such cases. I'm not talking about the cases when somebody blackmails witnesses or falsely testifies or perjures themselves. But if somebody discloses a secret is a crime or not, this is a different matter. I have just presented several problems that have hindered my defence and I hope that you will be able to deal with these problems unlike your colleagues in the previous trials.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Now, this leads me to my second question. Actually, you touched on it slightly when you spoke a while ago. Do you have any intention to call any witnesses during the presentation of your case?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would call three witnesses at the outside. They are well informed of the way my internal counsel operates and my activities. But the longest would be my own testimony and in that case I would need proofing by my legal assistant Dejan Mirovic, attorney-at-law, and he would be the one examining me. The cross-examination can be conducted by you or one of your colleagues or somebody from the Prosecution, I don't care. That's not my problem. But in examination-in-chief, I would be examined by my own legal assistant, by my own legal advisor, Dejan Mirovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber will in due course provide information as to the commencement of the trial. Now, then, Mr. Seselj, do you wish to raise any matter relating to your state of health or your condition of detention at all?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As for the conditions of detention I have to repeat something I've said at previous Status Conferences and in other cases related to me. The DU administration, now supported not only by the Registry but also by the President of the Tribunal, is stopping me from writing and making my own submissions. I write my submissions in long hand, and for all of the past nine years whenever I write a submission, I asked the guard on duty to make a photocopy for me so that I could submit the original and keep the photocopy as proof that I have indeed made the submission. Now two months ago, the DU administration banned this. Through my legal assistants I complained to the President of the Tribunal and he rejected my complaint. So in future whatever happens, I am no longer able to write anything myself or send anything to the Trial Chamber, to the President of the Tribunal, or the Registry. They prevented me. Why would I write anything if I can get no proof that I submitted it? The only possible proof can be a photocopy, and my submissions are not long, one to three pages at most. But they don't want to do it. They are deliberately making my case difficult for me and putting me under additional stress on purpose. As for my health, the darkest powers in this world, the Western powers, using their intelligence services continue to undermine my health and we'll see what the outcome will be. We'll see that very soon. But as long as I breathe, I will fight against this Hague Tribunal. And as they make the methods against me more sophisticated, my defiance and hatred for this illegal and anti-Serb Tribunal are greater and greater. I don't need to convince you of that, because my current condition has been artificially induced from outside. All the doctors that I asked at the university centre in Leiden said there is no internal physiological reason for my arrhythmia and tachycardia. It couldn't be the condition of my blood vessels or my blood tests. My blood vessels are in perfect condition. I never had increased blood sugar, triglycerides, or anything else that normally causes such problems. All that is happening to me, especially the last incident when the implanted ICD went totally crazy, tells me that somebody is intervening from outside. Somebody is timing the moment when they will end my life.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Is there any matter that you wish to raise at this stage over and above the matters you have already touched on?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. I would like to hear from you whether you intend to solve the problem of my meetings with my legal counsel and my case manager and whether the issue of proofing of my witnesses will be resolved as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BAIRD
utterances.text: Well, at this point in time, I am simply conducting this Status Conference, but your -- the points you have raised have been noted and certainly there are legal avenues that you could raise these issues through if you so desire. If there is nothing further, Mr. Registrar, at this stage we will adjourn the proceedings.
